z-m-22-08.title: Kunhamba nhatu dzine huwandu hwe6, huwandu hwemasquare adzo hwakagadziriswawo here?
z-m-22-08.goal: Ratidza nemienzaniso inopokana kuti huwandu hwemasquare hahuna kugadziriswa kana huwandu chete huzivikanwa, uye ushandise maexpression kuronga ruzivo rwaizvigadzirisa.
z-m-22-08.material: Kunhamba chaidzo a, b, c, zvinozivikanwa kuti a+b+c=6. Ngatione kana chokwadi ichi chichitibvumira kuziva kukosha kwe a²+b²+c², uye kana kwete, chimwe chii chinodiwa. (a² inoverengwa se"a squared".)
z-m-22-08.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwekuverenga kukosha kweexpression nekuisa nhamba
z-m-22-08.s.s1.prompt: Kunhamba chaidzo a, b, c, a+b+c=6 chete ndiyo inozivikanwa. Kukosha kwe a²+b²+c² i chii?
z-m-22-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba dzose nhatu dzine huwandu hwe6 uye uverenge a²+b²+c².
z-m-22-08.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza imwe seti yenhamba nhatu uye uenzanise kana kukosha kumwe chete kuchibuda.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.a: Yakagadziriswa pa36. Unogona kuiwana pakarepo nekuita square ye6
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti (a+b+c)² yakafanana ne a²+b²+c². Ongorora kuti mazwi ekuwedzera api anooneka kana ukawedzera (a+b+c)².
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.b: Yakagadziriswa pa12. Chiyero ndicho kukosha kunobva pakupatsanura 6 kuita zvikamu zvitatu zvakaenzana
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa nyaya a=b=c=2 chete. Ongorora kana nyaya dzimwe dzichipa kukosha kumwe chete.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.c: Haina kugadziriswa. Kukosha kunoenderana ne a, b, c
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakaona kuti kunyange nehuwandu hwakafanana, huwandu hwemasquare hunogona kuchinja kana a, b, c dzachinja.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.o.d: Yakagadziriswa, asi haigoni kuverengwa neruzivo runozivikanwa zvino
z-m-22-08.s.s1.r.d: Kana yakagadziriswa, kukosha kumwe chete kunofanira kubuda mumuenzaniso wose une huwandu hwe6. Edza nemienzaniso miviri.
z-m-22-08.s.s1.explain: Kana muenzaniso une huwandu hwe6 uri (2,2,2), ipapo a²+b²+c²=12, uye kana uri (6,0,0), i36, saka kukosha hakuna kugadziriswa kuita kumwe chete.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso miviri yenhamba nhatu ine a+b+c=6 asi makosha akasiyana e a²+b²+c², uye uratidze kuti kukosha hakuna kugadziriswa.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzira nhamba nhatu dzine huwandu hwe6, wobva waverenga huwandu hwemasquare uye uzvinyore mutebhura.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza mienzaniso miviri ine huwandu hwemasquare hwakasiyana.
z-m-22-08.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, (2,2,2) inopa 12, (6,0,0) inopa 36, (1,2,3) inopa 14, uye (4,1,1) inopa 18. Kunyange nehuwandu hwakafanana, huwandu hwemasquare hwakasiyana, saka a+b+c=6 oga haigadzirisi. Mienzaniso miviri inopa kukosha kumwe chete (semuenzaniso, (1,2,3) ne (3,2,1)) haina kuverengwa semienzaniso yakasiyana.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.prompt: Pamusoro pe a+b+c=6, ndezvipi zvezvokwadi zvinotevera, kana zvichizivikanwawo, zvaizogadzirisa kukosha kwe a²+b²+c² kuita kumwe chete? Sarudza zvose.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kune chokwadi chega chega, tsvaga mienzaniso miviri ine a²+b²+c² dzakasiyana kunyange kana chokwadi ichocho chichizivikanwa.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora chimiro chakawedzerwa che (a+b+c)² uye uongorore kuti chokwadi chipi chinozadza nzvimbo isina chinhu muexpression iyoyo.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.a: Tsvaga muenzaniso umo abc yakafanana asi a²+b²+c² dzakasiyana. (Semuenzaniso, (6,0,0) ne (3,3,0) ine abc=0)
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.b: Wakaona kuti zvinobatana sei ne a²+b²+c² muchimiro chakawedzerwa che (a+b+c)².
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.c: Ongorora kana, kunyange kana c yakagadziriswa, a ne b dzichigona kuramba dzichichinja dzichigutsa a+b=6−c.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.d: Wakaverenga kuti a²+b²+c² ne ab+bc+ca zvinoonekwa sei kana expression iyi yakawedzerwa.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.o.e: Chokwadi chekuti a²+b²+c² i12 kana kupfuura
z-m-22-08.s.s3.r.e: Funga kana iri ruzivo rutsva, sezvo ichatoshanda mumuenzaniso wose une huwandu hwe6.
z-m-22-08.s.s3.explain: Sezvo (a+b+c)²=a²+b²+c²+2(ab+bc+ca), kana uchiziva ab+bc+ca, ipapo a²+b²+c²=36−2(ab+bc+ca) yakagadziriswa. Sezvo (a−b)²+(b−c)²+(c−a)²=3(a²+b²+c²)−36, kuziva kukosha uku kunogadziriswawo. Kukosha kwe abc, kukosha kwe c, ne"12 kana kupfuura" hazvigadziri kukosha.

z-m-22-02.title: x⁴+4 haina real roots, asi inogona kunyorwa semusanganiswa here?
z-m-22-02.topic: Kupatsanura (hukama pakati pe roots ne factors, kushandura nekuwedzera nekubvisa term)
z-m-22-02.goal: Simbisa kupfuvura "kana pasina roots, haigoni kupatsanurwa" nemuenzaniso unopikisa neshanduko chaiyo, uye ugadzire ma expressions ako pachako apo nzira imwe chete inoshanda.
z-m-22-02.material: Tinotaura mukati merenji apo ma coefficients e polynomials ari ma real numbers. Jihu akati, "Hapana real x inogutsa x⁴+4=0. Saka x⁴+4 haigoni kupatsanurwa." Ngatitarisei kana tinogona kutenda chirevo chaJihu sezvachakaita. ("x⁴" inoverengwa se "x to the fourth power".)
z-m-22-02.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inogutsa mamiriro
z-m-22-02.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwekupatsanura quadratic expressions dzechimiro ax²+bx+c
z-m-22-02.s.s1.prompt: Ngatitarisei kuti kutonga nezve chirevo che "kana pasina real roots, haigoni kunyorwa semusanganiswa" kunochinja sei sezvo ruzivo rutsva ruchisvika.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakaparadzana kana ruzivo rumwe nerumwe rwunobata "chirevo chakajairika" kana rwunobata "x⁴+4 pachayo".
z-m-22-02.s.s1.hint.1: Wedzera expression yakapiwa iwe pachako uye utarise kana ichienzana ne expression yekutanga.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.info: x⁴ ndi0 kana kupfuura, saka x⁴+4 inogara iri 4 kana kupfuura. Ndiko kuti, hapana real x ine x⁴+4=0. Kana linear expression x−k iri factor, kukosha kwe expression kunofanira kuva 0 pa x=k, saka hapana linear factor ine real coefficients.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Neruzivo rwazvino chete, unotonga sei kana x⁴+4 inogona kunyorwa semusanganiswa we expressions mbiri kana kupfuura ine real coefficients?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvasimbiswa kuti hapana linear factor, asi mukana wemusanganiswa we quadratic expressions mbiri unoramba wakavhurika. Parizvino, zvinonzwisisika kumisa kutonga kwako kana kusiya mukana uchivhurika.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Haigoni kunyorwa. Hapana linear factor, saka haipatsanurwi kuita quadratic expressions zvakare
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakapfuura kubva pachokwadi chekuti hapana linear factor kuenda ku "hapana musanganiswa unoshanda". Wakafunga kana musanganiswa we quadratic expressions mbiri unogoneka here?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hazvisati zvaziva. Mukana wemusanganiswa we quadratic expressions mbiri unoramba
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uri kusiyanisa kusava ne linear factor nekusapatsanurwa kuita musanganiswa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Inogona kunyorwa. Kana 4 ikawedzerwa, inogara ichipatsanurwa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hairi kupatsanurwa nekungowedzerwa 4. Unoda chokwadi sehwaro.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Inogona kunyorwa. Ma expressions ane power even ose anopatsanurwa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: x²+1 ine expression ine power even, asi haipatsanurwi kuita linear expressions ine real coefficients. Funga muenzaniso unopikisa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Expression yakafanana x⁴+5x²+4 inewo pasina real roots nekuti x⁴+5x²+4≥4. Asi kana ukaona x² se A, saka A²+5A+4=(A+1)(A+4), saka x⁴+5x²+4 inogona kunyorwa se (x²+1)(x²+4).
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unotonga sei chirevo chakajairika chaJihu, "kana pasina real roots, haigoni kunyorwa semusanganiswa"?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.after: x⁴+5x²+4 haina real roots asi ichipatsanurwa kuita (x²+1)(x²+4), saka chirevo chakajairika chaJihu hachishande. Asi izvo hazvisimbisi kuti x⁴+4 inopatsanurwa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Chirevo chakajairika chaputsika. Asi kuti x⁴+4 inopatsanurwa here kunofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uri kusiyanisa kuti muenzaniso mumwe unopikisa unoputsa chirevo chakajairika, uye kuti expression chaiyo inopatsanurwa here nyaya yakaparadzana.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Zvino x⁴+4 zvechokwadi inogonawo kunyorwa semusanganiswa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Muenzaniso unopikisa unoputsa chirevo chakajairika chete; hauvimbisi kuti x⁴+4 inopatsanurwa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Chirevo chaJihu chichiri chakarurama. x⁴+5x²+4 i expression yakasiyana
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: "Kana pasina real roots, haipatsanurwi" chirevo che expressions dzose, saka expression imwe yakasiyana muenzaniso unopikisa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: x⁴+5x²+4 yakapatsanurwa nekuchinja x² kuita A, saka haigoni kushandiswa semuenzaniso unopikisa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wedzera (x²+1)(x²+4) uye utarise iwe pachako kana ichienzana ne expression yekutanga.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana ukawedzera nekubvisa 4x² mu x⁴+4, saka x⁴+4=(x⁴+4x²+4)−4x²=(x²+2)²−(2x)².
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Unogona kunyora sei x⁴+4 nekushandura uku?
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.after: (x²+2)²−(2x)²=(x²+2−2x)(x²+2+2x)=(x²−2x+2)(x²+2x+2). Tarisa kana kuwedzera kuchipa x⁴+4. Kunyange pasina real roots, inogona kunyorwa semusanganiswa we quadratic expressions mbiri.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: (x²+2)²−(2x)² ine kukosha kwakasiyana ne x⁴+4, saka haigoni kushandiswa
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wedzera (x²+2)² uye ubvise 4x², uye uverenge kana uchiwana x⁴+4.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: (x²+2)²−(2x)²=(x²+2)−(2x), saka inova quadratic expression imwe chete
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Musiyano wema squares ndi (A−B)(A+B), uye haiti expression imwe chete A−B.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Inova musanganiswa we quadratic expressions mbiri, (x²−2x+2)(x²+2x+2)
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakadzidza nzira yekushandura musiyano wema squares maviri kuita musanganiswa.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Musiyano wema squares maviri, saka haipatsanurwi zvakare mu real numbers
z-m-22-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: A²−B²=(A−B)(A+B) inoshanda chero ma expressions A ne B ari api.
z-m-22-02.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, chokwadi chekuti hapana linear factor hachina kukwana kusvika kumhedziso. Sezvo muenzaniso unopikisa neshanduko chaiyo zvakaonekwa, kutonga kwakagadzikana. Kana wakatanga wafungidzira kuti "haipatsanurwi", taura kuti ruzivo rupi rwakachinja pfungwa iyoyo.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.prompt: Ngatigadzirei ma expressions x⁴+c² apo nzira imwe chete ne x⁴+4 inoshanda mukati me integer coefficients. Kana uchinyora zvakare x⁴+c² muchimiro (x²+c)²−(dx)², hukama hupi c ne d dzinofanira kuva nahwo? Tsvaga mapeya maviri akasiyana apo c ne d dziri natural numbers uye c iri 3 kana kupfuura.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.hint.0: Wedzera (x²+c)² uye uenzanise kuti term ipi inosiyana ne x⁴+c².
z-m-22-02.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti term yasara inofanira kuva square yenhamba ipi, uye mushure mekusarudza d, verenga c.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.ok.c1: c ndi3 kana kupfuura uye d ndi natural number.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c1: c inofanira kuva 3 kana kupfuura uye d inofanira kuva 1 kana kupfuura.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c2: c ne d dzinofanira kuva integers.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.fail.c3: (x²+c)²=x⁴+2cx²+c², saka (dx)² ne 2cx² dzinofanira kuenzana. Enzanisa d² ne2c.
z-m-22-02.s.s2.explain: x⁴+c²=(x²+c)²−2cx², saka kana 2c iri square ye integer d², inopatsanurwa kuita (x²−dx+c)(x²+dx+c). (c, d)=(8, 4) inopa x⁴+64=(x²−4x+8)(x²+4x+8), (18, 6) inopa x⁴+324=(x²−6x+18)(x²+6x+18), uye (32, 8) inopa x⁴+1024=(x²−8x+32)(x²+8x+32). Kana real coefficients dzabvumirwa, inopatsanurwa kune c ipi neipi positive ne d=√(2c), asi kana yakadzorwa kuma integers, hukama hwakadai hunodiwa.

z-m-22-03.title: Tinogona kudzidzazve chii kubva pachokwadi chekuti ma remainders akafanana?
z-m-22-03.topic: Kushandisa remainder theorem (ma remainders kubva ma linear expressions akawanda)
z-m-22-03.goal: Shanda kuti kutonga nezve remainder kana wapatsanura ne quadratic expression kunochinja sei sezvo zvokwadi zve remainders zvichiwedzerwa rimwe panguva, uye ugadzire iwe pachako ma expressions akawanda anogutsa mamiriro akafanana.
z-m-22-03.material: f(x) i polynomial ine real coefficients uye degree yayo haizikanwi. Polynomial division inonyorwa muchimiro f(x)=(divisor)·(quotient)+(remainder), uye degree ye remainder iri pasi pe degree ye divisor. Sezvo zvokwadi zvichizikanwa rimwe panguva, ngatitarisei kuti chii chinogona kutaurwa nezve remainder kana f(x) yaparadzaniswa ne (x−1)(x−2).
z-m-22-03.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa kana ruzivo rutsva ruchichinja kutonga uye kana rusingachinji
z-m-22-03.thinking.2: Kugadzira ma expressions akawanda anogutsa mamiriro
z-m-22-03.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekunyora remainder ye polynomial yakaparadzaniswa ne linear expression muchimiro f(x)=(divisor)(quotient)+remainder
z-m-22-03.s.s1.prompt: Ngatitarisei kuti kutonga kwangu pamusoro pechasara pakuparadzanisa ne (x−1)(x−2) kunochinja sei sezvo zvokwadi pamusoro pezvasara zvichiwedzerwa chimwe panguva imwe. (Degree ye f(x) haizikanwi.)
z-m-22-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora patsva chokwadi chimwe nechimwe sechirevo pamusoro pekukosha, senge "f(1)=…".
z-m-22-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora chasara se ax+b uye uverenge zvirevo zvinoburitswa nechokwadi chimwe nechimwe, rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Chokwadi 1: Chasara kana f(x) yaparadzaniswa ne x−1 ndi 4.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unogona kutaura chii izvozvi pamusoro pechasara kana f(x) yaparadzaniswa ne (x−1)(x−2)?
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana chasara chiri ax+b, ipapo kubva pachokwadi 1 chirevo chimwe chete, a+b=4, chinobuda, saka a ne b hazvina kugadzikana.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Chasara ndi 4 (chinhu chisingachinji). Nokuti ndi 4 pa x=1
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hapana ruzivo pamusoro pe x−2 parizvino. Funga kana f(2) inofanira kuva 4 zvakare kuti chasara chive 4.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Chirevo che degree 1 kana shoma, uye ruzivo urwu oga haruchigadziri
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakatarisa zvose chimiro chechasara (degree 1 kana shoma) nokushaikwa kweruzivo.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Chasara ndi 4x. Nokuti kukosha kuri 4 pa x=1
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Pane zvirevo zvakawanda kunze kwa 4x zvine kukosha 4 pa x=1.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hazvina chokuita ne x−1, saka hapana chinogona kutaurwa
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Patova nemugumo wokuti chasara ndi 4 pa x=1. Hausi kuziva chinhu.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Chokwadi 2: Chasara kana f(x) yaparadzaniswa ne x−2 zvakare ndi 4.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino chasara kana yaparadzaniswa ne (x−1)(x−2) chii?
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kubva pa a+b=4 ne 2a+b=4, a=0 uye b=4, saka chasara chinhu chisingachinji 4. Izvi nokuti kana f(1)=f(2)=4, f(x)−4 inoparadzaniswa ne x−1 ne x−2 zvose.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hachisati chagadzika. Pane chirevo chimwe chete chakawedzerwa
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Zvino pane zvirevo zviviri. Tarisa kana ungawana a ne b kubva pazvirevo zviviri.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kukosha ndi 5 pa x=2, izvo zvisingaenderani nechokwadi 2.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatonga uchishandisa zvirevo zviviri a+b=4 ne 2a+b=4 pamwe chete.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kukosha ndi 6 pa x=1, izvo zvisingaenderani nechokwadi 1.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Chokwadi 3: Chasara kana f(x) yaparadzaniswa ne x−3 ndi 5. (Semuenzaniso, f(x)=½x²−(3/2)x+5 inogutsa zvokwadi 1, 2, ne 3.)
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kana chokwadi ichi chawedzerwa, chasara pakuparadzanisa ne (x−1)(x−2) chichachinja here?
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Pamuenzaniso f(x)=½x²−(3/2)x+5, f(x)−4=½(x−1)(x−2), saka chasara pakuparadzanisa ne (x−1)(x−2) chinoramba chiri 4. Chokwadi 3 ruzivo pamusoro pepoinzi rakasiyana, f(3)=5.
z-m-22-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hachichinji. Chokwadi 3 ruzivo pamusoro pe x=3 chete

z-m-22-05.s.s1.prompt: f(x) ne g(x) mapolynomial asiri zero ane makoefficient chaiwo. Ma degree emapolynomial maviri anogona kugadzikwa kubva pazvokwadi zvokuti degree yechigadzirwa f(x)g(x) i 6 uye degree yehuwandu f(x)+g(x) i 3 chete here?

z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandisa degree 6 yechigadzirwa chete uye hauna kushandisa degree 3 yehuwandu. Tarisa kuti degree yehuwandu i ipi kuna (degree 6, degree 0).

z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.b: Pane mapeya akawanda ane degree yechigadzirwa 6, asi wakasefa vakasarudzwa nemamiriro okuti huwandu hune degree 3 here?

z-m-22-05.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandisa degree 3 yehuwandu chete uye hauna kushandisa degree 6 yechigadzirwa. Tarisa kuti chigadzirwa chechirevo che degree 3 nechirevo che degree iri pasi chine degree ipi.

z-m-22-06.goal: Tonga kana zvisingazivikanwi zvakagadziriswa kwete nenhamba yemamiriro asi nenhamba yeruzivo rwakazvimiririra, uye usarudze mamiriro ari chirevo chimwe chakanyorwa nenzira dzakasiyana kana mamiriro anguva dzose ari chokwadi.

z-m-22-06.s.s2.r.e: Chasara pakugovanisa ne x+2 i f(−2). Ruzivo rwenzvimbo yakasiyana ne x=1, ndiko kuti x=−2, saka runogadzira ma equation maviri akazvimiririra, a+b=5 ne 2a−b=4.

z-m-22-07.goal: Wana nenzira yakarongeka mhinduro dzakawanda dzinoita kuti expression yakanyorwa sechigadzirwa ienzane neexpression yecubic yakapihwa, uye utsanangure kana vanokwanisika vakaongororwa zvakakwana uye kuti nei mhinduro inobviswa nekusaenderana kwecoefficient imwe chete.

z-m-22-04.s.s3.r.d: Iko kukosha kana x isina kunaka. Kana x iri yakanaka, tarisa chiratidzo che x+1/x.
z-m-22-04.s.s3.explain: Kana x>0, ipapo x+1/x>0, saka u=3. x³+1/x³=u³−3u=27−9=18. (Kana x<0, ipapo u=−3 uye ndi −18.)

z-m-22-12.title: x⁴−4 inofanira kupatsanurwa kusvika papi isati yapera?
z-m-22-12.topic: Factoring (kupatsanura kwakazara zvichienderana nerange yema coefficients)
z-m-22-12.goal: Nzwisisa kuti kutonga kuti factoring "yapera" kunoenderana nerange yema coefficients, uye usarudze kuti unonyora sei mhinduro kana pasina range yakapiwa.
z-m-22-12.material: Pane mhinduro nhatu dze x⁴−4. Mhinduro ①: (x²−2)(x²+2), Mhinduro ②: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2), Mhinduro ③: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x−√2i)(x+√2i). Mhinduro nhatu dzese dzinopa x⁴−4 kana dzawedzerwa. Mu factoring, mutsara "haupatsanuri zvakare" unoenderana nenhamba dzinobvumidzwa semacoefficients.
z-m-22-12.prereq.2: Zvinoreva zvakakosha zvema complex numbers (imaginary unit i, i²=−1)
z-m-22-12.s.s1.prompt: Pane mhinduro nhatu dzinopatsanura x⁴−4. Mhinduro ①: (x²−2)(x²+2). Mhinduro ②: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2). Mhinduro ③: (x−√2)(x+√2)(x−√2i)(x+√2i). Sarudza zvirevo zvese zvakarurama zvinotevera. (i i imaginary unit uye i²=−1.)
z-m-22-12.s.s1.hint.0: Wedzera zvinhu zvemhinduro imwe neimwe uye utarise kana uchiwana x⁴−4.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.hint.1: Funga imwe neimwe kuti chinhu chega chega chinopatsanurwa zvakare here nema coefficients ari murange iyoyo.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.a: Kana ma coefficients akaganhurirwa kuma integers, mhinduro ① haigone kupatsanurwa zvakare
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.a: Unoziva kuti "magumo" anosarudzwa nerange yema coefficients yaunoshandisa.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.b: Kana ma coefficients akabvumidzwa kusvika kuma real numbers, mhinduro ① haisati yapatsanurwa zvizere
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.b: Wakaona kuti mu real numbers, x²−2 inopatsanurwa kuita mitsara miviri ye linear.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.c: x²+2 inopatsanurwa kuita (x−√2)(x+√2) mu real numbers
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.c: Kuwedzera (x−√2)(x+√2) kunopa x²−2. Tarisa kana yakafanana ne x²+2.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.d: Zvisinei nerange yema coefficients yaunoshandisa, mhinduro ① i factorization yekupedzisira
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.d: Pane mitsara inogona kupatsanurwa zvakawanda kana range yema coefficients ichiwedzera.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.o.e: Kana ma complex numbers akabvumidzwa, x²+2 inopatsanurwawo kuita chigadzirwa chemitsara miviri ye linear
z-m-22-12.s.s1.r.e: Wakaona kuti mhinduro dze x²+2=0 i imaginary, saka mu complex numbers inopatsanurwa kuita mitsara ye linear.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.explain: "Magumo" e factoring anoenderana nerange yema coefficients. Mu integers i (x²−2)(x²+2), mu real numbers i (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2), uye mu complex numbers i chigadzirwa chemitsara mina ye linear. x²+2 haipatsanurwi zvakare mu real numbers, uye (x−√2)(x+√2)=x²−2.
z-m-22-12.s.s1.acc.0: a ne b dzakasarudzwa zvakarurama. Kana ukafungawo nezverange inoshandisa complex numbers (e), inova yakazara zvakanyanya.
z-m-22-12.s.s2.prompt: Mubvunzo, mubvunzo unoti chete "Patsanura x⁴−4" uye range yema coefficients haina kunyorwa. Unganyora sei mhinduro yako? Inyore nezvikonzero.
z-m-22-12.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti imwe neimwe ye ①, ②, ③ i mhinduro yerange ipi yema coefficients.
z-m-22-12.s.s2.hint.1: Kana usingagone kuziva kuti mutongi anotarisira ipi, funga kuti zvingave zvakanaka kunyora chii mumhinduro.
z-m-22-12.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti wakafungidzira range ipi yema coefficients mumhinduro yako here?
z-m-22-12.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora uchiziva kuti zvinosiyana sei mumarange akasiyana here?
z-m-22-12.s.s2.model.0: Ndichataura range zvakasiyana. Mu integers, i (x²−2)(x²+2), uye kana real numbers dzakabvumidzwa, ndichanyora (x−√2)(x+√2)(x²+2).
z-m-22-12.s.s2.model.1: Kana pasina chakataurwa, kazhinji inotorwa serange yema integer coefficients, saka ndichanyora (x²−2)(x²+2), uye ndichawedzera kuti kana zvakawanda zvabvumidzwa, uchishandisa √2 inopatsanurwa zvakare.
